notes.title: Going Social: Using Twitter and Discord!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We have lots of awesome news to share today and we are excited to finally air it out.

First off, with the feedback we have been receiving and the work we are continuing to put into the game, it might be a good idea to keep you all more informed a lot more efficiently and on the fly. Thus, social media presence! Today we not have an official Twitter account you all may follow and a shiny Discord server!


[u]The Twitter handle is as follows: https://twitter.com/CatvsCorgis[/u]

Here, we will post frequent updates about coming changes, major updates and the best part, talking to you all! Now, treat the Twitter handle as a resource to voice any of your opinions or questions you may have about the game. The community will be sure to get to you or even one of us so that we may address your concerns and work towards seeing solutions. We hope this will be a good tool as we try to relay future interaction and news relating to our game.


[u]The Discord handle is as follows: https://discord.gg/SnaD53y[/u]

And for this one, we gladly thank the personal efforts of [b]Tori[/b], alias [b]LeRoyalGamer[/b] They took the time to make a Discord server dedicated to Cat vs. Corgis. Right now, It is titled under being a "Speedrunner" server, however, anyone is welcome and there are many channels that will be made available to you all. Things from fanart, announcements and even current speedrunning records and leaderboards will all be here. We here at Team 7 Lives will be there as well if you would like to mention us on anything. There is a great mod team keeping it afloat and we hope you join us! Also, please be respectful. Forum rules will carry to our Discord so be respectful, do not spam and there will be no issues. 


Things have been going so well since our release and there is a lot of thanks to go out to a lot of you. We want to continue to better ourselves anyway we can. With new resources, we hope you make the best of them in any way you see fit whether that is sticking around as a fan, speedrunning against the community or even yelling at us because something is broken and we just have to fix it. We shall see you all soon. Stay tuned for upcoming updates regarding our next major update! Maybe there will be something to achieve sometime soon. ;)


Deepest regards,

Alex Suffoletto and Team 7 Lives

notes.title: Update 1.02 | Game Breakers and Facelifts All Around!
notes.notes:
Our first big patch is out and it is so bittersweet. Below we listed some new additions of content and a list of our bug fixes that was preventing progress or just being a bit of a nuisance. Please note that we are aware of much more bugs in our game and we hope to squash them in future patches like odd camera transitions and features acting a bit weird with both textures and gameplay.

First off, the bad news. Our updates are overwritting save files! ːsteamsadː

[i] Thanks to you players for bringing this to our attention. Save files are overwritten upon new implemented updates. We apologize for this inconvenience and are at work to make sure this is resolved ASAP. I posted a guide to a temporary solution as we approach this concern for future updates. You can find the guide in our Bug Reports and Techinical Isses Sub Forum here on Steam! [/i]

Now onto the good stuff!

[h1] Features and Content [/h1] 

* CONTENT - New "Facelift" to the Treasury Level! New textures and camera tweaking for smoother gameplay plus some great new textures and envrionmental assets throughout!
* New Credits cutscene! Go beat the game and see our new little segment we made for you all!
* CONTENT (WIP) - Steam Achievements implemented! CANNOT be UNLOCKED yet but will be available soon! Stay tuned for more details!
* FEATURE - Raised camera on the King Corgi boss room.
* FEATURE - Prevent player from moving around the chessboard in unintended ways (New colliders to progress player direction as intended, check bug fixes for specific details).
* FEATURE - Erase feature for save files. 

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1] 

* Fix persistent switches (FINALLY)
    Fixed the switches in the Treasury level that prevents players from progressing and completing the Treasury Level on death or level reload.
* Changed version to 1.02 in title and credits
* Invisible walls in Garden Hub
    Fixed a bug that allows Stretch to jump over the hedge and go past locked gates in the Garden Hub
* Treasury_Levels appearing on Save Files
    "Treasury_Levels" should now read "Treasury" and "Labyrinth_Level" should now read "Labyrinth" on the save file buttons
* Made version text on the main menu smaller
* Fixed colliders on Chess Pieces during King Corgi Boss.
* Blocked the edges of the chessboards to keep Stretch from escaping
* Fixed Camera Angle Smoothness in Labyrinth/Treasury Level.
* Fixed Treasury Level not transitioning to second half of the level (would go to boss immediately after the Labyrinth section without having to do the Treasury portion of the level)


We want to thank you all so much again for your feedback on our game. This update would not have been possible without you all! Seeing more people jump in and let us know what is going on is keeping our passion high and making us want to continue to improve Cat vs. Corgis! It may not be perfect but we will keep on pushing out what we can until we feel the game is at a great point with us here developing and with you, the community! Please continue to send us feedback as we continue to go forward and let us know what you think along the way. Keep on swinging! :)

Deepest regards,

Team 7 Lives - Alex Suffoletto ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Upcoming Updates and "Cubic Bundle" Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

     We just wanted to thank everyone who has been playing Cat vs. Corgis with our feline Stretch! We have heard and seen you enjoy parts of our games, laugh at some silly situations and even got feedback about your experiences with the game thus far. Good and bad. We just want to thank you all for the support you have given us and to let you know we are listening! 



     We are currently working hard to bring some well deserved updates to Cat vs. Corgis. There are some bugs making some of our level functionality not work as intended have put that at the top of our priority list for those of you have not been able to finish the game due to such. A big issue is the Labyrinth/Treasury switches not working as intended. We also spotted many other minor bugs thanks to the videos and comments you have made and are looking at those too! There is even going to be some sections getting a face lift with some new textures and camera tweaks.

     We will continue to push updates as long as you all continue to keep us informed. We want to make sure this game will be in a great state for everyone.


     The last thing to mention is we made a deal with an awesome bundle service called, "Cubic Bundle"! If you have this game on your wishlist or hoping to maybe share it with some of your friends this would be an awesome time to grab it! It even includes some other indie titles from developers like us. Check the link below to go see our bundle and other titles. It will be up for another 26 days as of 9/8/2017.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30189140/7420b6adbf9224c41a9b2b53c8599d2c081a6c51.jpg[/img]
https://cubicbundle.com/steam-bundle-indie-2

     Thank you everyone and looking forward to seeing more of you join us for our future with Cat vs. Corgis! 

Deepest regards,

Alex Suffoletto and Team 7 Lives ːsteamhappyː
